This '''hospital''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. The healer [[Serra]], daughter of [[Caleb]], worked in the [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] as a nurse for a time. In [[987 BBY]], after a failed attempt to capture an [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Salto Zendar]] came to the hospital to receive treatment for his wounds. However, the Banking Clan put a large [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head, and several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] soon arrived to try to take him into custody. During the [[Skirmish in the Bandomeer hospital|ensuing skirmish]], Zendar was [[Death/Legends|killed]], along with several bounty hunters, hospital staff, and nurses. However, one of the bounty hutners, [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], was saved by Serra, and Lucia vowed to become Serra's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]].
